sections.title: Sound of C
paragraphs: The letter name is (C) /ʃ/. Its main sound is the sound /k/, as heard in (cat) /kæt/. This word means a small furry pet. The letter can make two different spoken sounds, or it can stay silent.

sections.title: How to say C
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the back of your tongue against the roof of your mouth. Release a quick puff of air without using your voice. For the second sound, place your tongue tip near your upper teeth. Blow air smoothly through the narrow gap. You can place a hand on your throat to check that your vocal cords stay still.

sections.title: Spelling of C
paragraphs: This letter makes the sound /k/ before the vowels a, o, u or consonants, as in (cup) /kʌp/. It makes the sound /s/ before e, i, or y, like in (city) /sɪ.ti/ or (cent) /sɛnt/. In some special words, this letter is silent and you make no sound at all, as in (muscle) /mʌs.əl/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with C
paragraphs: Do not soften the hard sound into a hissing sound when you see the letter before a consonant. Keep the back of your tongue firm to stop the air completely. Before the letters e and i, do not use the hard tapping sound at the back of your mouth. Instead, let the air hiss gently between your teeth.
